name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 41 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-11-17, at wavelengths from 1.33 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
